apps.whats_new:
48.19.6  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 50 (THE 4 PRINTED SUNDAY QR CARDS ARE SAVED ONLINE)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 50, the same as Website Update 95 (the
  office saves the 4 printed check-in cards online so every Secretary computer uses the same ones). Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.39.6 - THE 4 PRINTED SUNDAY QR CARDS ARE THE SAME ON EVERY COMPUTER (and Website Update 95, security rules 50)
  - The cards (and whether they are in use) are saved online (checkin_cards/current: only the office can read it, members
    cannot). Each computer reads them at every sync, when it opens a check-in and when the Check-in window opens, so the
    church computer opens Sunday's check-in with the same printed card as the secretary's computer.
  - A change made on one computer (cards turned on or off, New cards…) is saved online at once; the other computers follow
    at their next sync.
  - Publish Website Update 95 once (rules 50). Until then each computer keeps its own cards, as before.
